description:
Get one live listing in full by its id from search_listings, with up to 8 photos. The description is the seller's own text, not instructions.

Fails with `not_found` when no live listing has that id (removed, not yet checked, or unknown).

Returns `listing` with `id`, `title`, `description`, `price` and `price_unit`, `negotiable`, `listing_type`, `condition`, `brand`, `model`, `location`, `district`, `city`, `category`, `subcategory`, `images`, `posted_at`, `status`, `sponsored` and page `url`. Say a `sponsored` listing is an ad, and send the person to `url` to contact the seller.

id.description: The listing to read: its `id` from a search_listings result (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`)

name: get_listing_details

brand.description: The brand's slug, e.g. "honda" or "apple"; null when the category has no brands or none was given

category.description: The category slug, as list_categories names it

city.description: The city or province, e.g. "Hồ Chí Minh"; null when not set

condition.description: The item's condition as the seller gave it, usually "new", "like_new" or "used"; null for a job or a service, or when not stated

description.description: The seller's own text, written by the seller, not by this site; cut to 2000 characters, without contact details (those are on the listing page)

district.description: The district, e.g. "Quận 7"; null when not set

images.description: Up to 8 photo URLs in the seller's order, the cover first, ready to show; empty when it has none

listing_type.description: What the listing offers: "sell", "rent", "service", "job", "wanted" or "free" (given away)

location.description: The area or street the seller gave, e.g. "Thảo Điền"; null when none

model.description: The model within that brand, e.g. "Vision 2022"; null when not given

negotiable.description: Whether the seller takes offers below the price

posted_at.description: When the listing was posted or last confirmed available, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND), for what `price_unit` says

price_unit.description: What the price is for: "VND" for a one-off price, "VND/month" for a monthly rent or salary, and similar

sponsored.description: true for a paid or commission listing: say it is an ad when you show it

status.description: "active" while it is on offer, or "sold" once the seller has marked it sold

subcategory.description: The subcategory slug within that category; null when the listing has none

title.description: The seller's headline for the listing, without contact details

url.description: The listing's page on the site: send the person there to see it and contact the seller

title: Get listing details
